rules.message: Do not treat balcony outer sash, interior partition sash, and direct-exterior room double sash as the same item or price basis.
No final sash order or quantity without measured clear opening W x H, divided sash segments, frame/glass specification and field evidence.
Keep legacy 자평 price unit intact; do not convert to square metres or reuse historical rates without explicit quote/unit validation.
For each physical sash assembly use distinct opening ID, side and location. Count inner and outer balcony units separately, but never double-charge the same assembly.
Bedroom and bathroom enclosed rooms must each have a validated entrance connection, but an open foyer-living or living-kitchen passage does not automatically require a door.
Balcony sliding access is included within its sash item; do not bill an additional ABS door for the same physical opening.
A proposed kitchen turning door needs verified existing opening or approved feasible structural design, hinge direction, adjacent kitchen/washer clearance and weather details.
Nominal door dimensions on SketchUp schematic are not site measurements. Distinguish frame opening, clear walking width, door leaf and height, plus elderly threshold needs.
Build spatial adjacency graph from real room connections; all required living/bedroom/bathroom areas must be reachable from outside entry. Master ensuite bath can be accessed through bedroom.
Compare KB and Npay/Naver floorplan by complex, exact area/subtype and rotate/mirror; field photos and measurement override unproven schematic.

historical_quote_only.note: Historic user-owned estimates. Not current procurement prices and not preset for a new customer.
